metadata.title: Quantitative finiteness of monic characters of knots
metadata.abstract: Dunfield, Friedl, and Jackson showed that if the $SL(2, \mathbb{C})$-character variety of a knot has an irreducible curve component that contains the character of an irreducible representation and a character with nonmonic twisted Alexander polynomial, then this component has only finitely many characters with monic twisted Alexander polynomials. In this paper, we give explicit upper bounds on the number of such characters in terms of a presentation of the knot group. In particular, we give upper bounds in terms of the crossing number of the knot.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 结特征簇中首一特征的定量有限性
analysis.workSummary: 在含不可约表示特征和非首一扭曲 Alexander 多项式特征的不可约曲线分支上，以结群表示及交叉数给出首一特征个数的显式上界。
analysis.breakthrough: 将既有有限性结论有效化为可计算数量界。
analysis.limitations: 需满足所述曲线分支与非首一点假设，不涵盖任意特征簇分支。
analysis.priorityReason: 将既有有限性结论有效化为可计算数量界。
